title: Message actions on hover
evidence: Looked at on the oracle 2026-11-13 (0.79.3, look only): resting the pointer on a message shows nothing. No element labelled 'Message actions…' is in the page before or during a hover (pointer moved onto the last bubble in steps, window in front, 0.9 s wait). Yet such an element exists at times: the long-answer trace shows a div 'Message actions for … message at <time>' being removed at the moment of a send. Each message is a role=article with tabindex=0, so the actions may come with keyboard focus or a secondary click. Neither is a recipe yet, so neither was tried. Next: a look-only recipe that Tab-focuses a message, then one for a secondary click. Oracle 1.0.3, 2026-11-14 (parity/oracle/cancel.json): the labels Reply to your message, More message actions, Add reaction and Reply to Oracle message showed with the pointer over a message. 0.79.3 had none. Their look is not captured yet (a look-only sweep on 1.0.3).
